state:
**Goal `completion-files`, Stages 3 and 4 are green.** Hover, go-to-definition, the strict check and the Deprecated hint with its quick fix are done (module docs of `hover.rs`, `definition.rs`, `diagnostics.rs` and `actions.rs`).

`diagnostics::from_completion_files` in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/diagnostics.rs` is the one walk over the string literal arguments of the entry document. It gives the strict warning `W1020` (in a `.nvs` file only) and the hint `W1021` (`W_COMPLETION_VALUE_DEPRECATED`, severity `Help`, so `HINT` on the wire). `to_wire` adds the `Deprecated` tag to `W1021` by its code. Where the value names a `replacement`, the hint carries an unsafe suggestion over the text between the quotes, escaped with `completion::escaped`. `actions::at` now takes `&CompletionFiles` and reads the same walk after the phase-gated compiler diagnostics, so the fix is offered where the hint is. The server passes the loaded set; the `.lspt` suite and `tests/actions.rs` pass an empty one.

Not written yet: the literal union (Stage 5) and the VS Code schema (Stage 6), both red on the driver's sweep.

next.title: a parameter typed as a union of string literals completes its members

items.text: **A string argument at a literal-union parameter offers its members** (`rule:ide/completion-offers-only-what-the-compiler-derived`, `rule:types/literal-types`). The checker records each parameter's declared type on the call it resolved, `ResolvedCall::param_tys` at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr_table.rs:110`. `arguments::name` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/arguments.rs:137` reads that call already for `param_names`. Where the parameter's type is a union of string literal types, offer each literal as an item of kind `value`, merged with a completion file's values for the same parameter (standing decision). `named_values` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs:687` is where a file's values are offered today, and its item edit escapes for the quote. A quote must open the list there too (`completion::continues_a_trigger`). Test: `a_string_argument_at_a_literal_union_parameter_offers_its_members`.

**Stage 6: the VS Code client's schema** — `editors/vscode/schemas/completion-file.json` does not exist. The fields it describes are the closed set `Value` reads at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion_files.rs:191` (`rule:ide/completion-files-offer-values-at-named-parameters` § *What a file says*). `bun nv loop --list --stage 6` prints what its check runs.

backlog: Stage 6 also owes the client's file watcher registration check, if its stage lists one; see `bun nv loop --list --stage 6`.
